description: Reopen r-sort-3-corpus-mdb (MDB) read-only. On table-type recordsets with Index set: Seek "=" and Seek ">=" with every value of T on IX_K (exact BSTR units, one Null), reading NoMatch and the ID of the current record after each; the same two operators with a small sample of each group on IX_KD; every value of U on IX_K. Then on DG (1,536 rows over three repeated 100-character keys, IX_K) the five operators = >= > <= < with the present key b x100, an absent key between a x100 and b x100, a key after all and an empty key, reading NoMatch and ID after each. Asks which row each key selects (equal-key winner, lone and mixed-unit keys) and the operator policy over duplicate groups.
